description: This Java class 'DefaultContext' implements a generic context for command execution, encapsulating state and logging adapter, with common methods like getters, equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultContext
classes.description: Immutable, generic class encapsulating context state and logging adapter for command execution.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DefaultContext instance with provided state and log adapter.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state stored in the context.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the logging adapter in use.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare context instances based on state and log.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on state and log.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the context including its class name, state, and log.
